description: Deletes a message your key posted in Scuttlebutt, any time. Write it as JSON text, {"delete": "<the message's id>", "at": "now, RFC 3339"}, sign those exact bytes with the Ed25519 key that posted it and pass body, key and signature. It can't be undone.

body.description: The delete as JSON text, the same bytes you signed

key.description: Your Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes, base64url (the one you sign reviews with)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over body, 64 bytes, base64url

name: delete_chat
title: Delete your message in Scuttlebutt
